description: ODC: REST consumed with POST and BODY, which the ODC lane only had in GET (rest-consume.json). Mirrors tests/jobs/rest-consume-post.json over the InsuranceApp fixture: IRestClient with Basic Authentication, a fixed client header (IExtendedProperty), request structure and response structure, IRestAction POST with RequestFormat/ResponseFormat JSON and timeout, body input in BodyPlacement, header input with OriginalName (X-Api-Key, a name that is not an OutSystems identifier), body output in BodyPlacement and an output read from a response header (ETag). The concrete type comes from the ServiceStudio.Plugin.REST plugin of ODC Studio, the same path as the GET. PLATFORM DIFFERENCE (measured, not assumed): the O11 job writes Username and Password on the IRestClient; in ODC the two properties EXIST and are writable through the API, but Verify refuses them as an ERROR: 'CustomObjectError: Invalid Password | Password is not supported, please remove it using Model API. @ InsuranceApp (ESpace) / WfCovOrdersApi (RestClient) / Password (CustomProperty)' (same for Username). API surface is not functionality: in ODC the authentication MODE stays in the model (AuthenticationType=BasicAuthentication, ClientAuthentication=SendAsBasicAuthHeader, read back by the get) and the CREDENTIALS stay outside it. That is why this job does not write them; the rest of the POST is exact parity with the O11 lane.
